articles.title: Nvidia Crisis Complicates Trump’s China Trip
articles.summary: On Bloomberg This Weekend, co-host of Bloomberg Surveillance Annmarie Hordern examines how scrutiny surrounding Nvidia and Jensen Huang is shifting the focus of President Donald Trump’s China trip from trade toward chip export controls and questions about how restricted technology may have reached China. Speaking with host Christina Ruffini, Hordern also discusses mounting pressure on the Commerce Department and how the controversy could lead Congress to pursue tighter controls on advanced chips and computing power. (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.title_zh: 英伟达危机使特朗普的中国之行更加复杂

articles.title: Trump Heads to Asia With Trade, Security at Stake
articles.summary: Bloomberg’s Avril Hong is on Bloomberg This Weekend to preview President Donald Trump’s trip to Asia, where trade, security ties and China’s growing regional influence are expected to shape meetings with Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and other Southeast Asian leaders. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Hong also examines the business stakes surrounding the trip, including Elon Musk’s reported participation and the debate over US restrictions on China’s access to advanced semiconductor technology. (Source: Bloomberg)
